device.description: 12-bit 50 kSPS micropower SAR ADC with I2C interface and 4-word result buffer
device.note: ads7823.pdf (SBAS180B) p.2-3 specifications at 3 V (conversion time 8 us, VIH, straight binary, hardware address 10010, VDD 2.7-3.6 V), p.4 specifications at 5 V (VDD 4.75-5.25 V), pin configuration and descriptions, p.10 address byte, command byte, initiating conversion, Figure 3, p.11 reading data, F/S and HS modes, p.12 terminating a conversion

commands.name: Command Byte
commands.note: p.10: three zeros then five don't-care bits; a byte with any of the top three bits set is ignored (no match)

pages: p.2 (conversion time 8 us), p.3 (VIH 0.7 VDD to VDD+0.5 V, straight binary, address 10010, VDD 2.7-3.6 V), p.4 (VDD 4.75-5.25 V; MSOP pin configuration and descriptions), p.10 (address byte 1001 0 A1 A0 R/W, command byte 000XXXXX, Figure 3), p.11 (two-byte data word 0000 D11-D8 / D7-D0, four-word FILO in F/S mode, HS mode), p.12 (terminating a conversion)
notModeled: analog input and reference (result is the 0 V code 000h)
the 4-level FILO of F/S mode: up to four words read after one command byte are all the same 0 V code (read repeats); more than four reads return undefined data
HS mode (master code, clock stretching until the conversion completes) and I2C timing limits
a second consecutive valid command byte is NACKed and powers the converter down; a STOP terminates the conversion; power-down/wake-up states have no other bus effect
reads before any command byte: the datasheet says data can only be read after a conversion was initiated; the model returns the 0 V code
vcc covers the two specified supply ranges (2.7-3.6 V and 4.75-5.25 V) as one range; the 3.6-4.75 V gap is not specified by the datasheet
A1/A0 are sampled at power-up only (the model reads them live)
variants: ADS7823EB is the higher-grade ADS7823 (same spec).
